title: Saudargas And Baker Seasons Greetings A Santa Fe Christmas Cassette
descriptionText: "Saudargas And Baker Seasons Greetings A Santa Fe Christmas Cassette" is a holiday music cassette featuring classic Christmas tracks by the artists Saudargas and Baker. Released by Rudolph Records, this cassette is perfect for celebrating the holiday season with festive music. The cassette comes in a standard jewel case, making it a convenient and timeless addition to any Christmas music collection.
